name: Grilled Sirloin Steak with Pineapple, Carrot, Cilantro & Broccoli Slaw

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 medium carrots
1 ½ small pineapples
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a large bowl. Add oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp turmeric, ground

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Cut off skin from pineapples; core and small dice. Add to the bowl.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with the broccoli slaw; toss to combine the coleslaw and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and coleslaw between plates or bowls; enjoy!
